The House of Representatives today passed a bill permitting women of 25 years or older to ”ote in elections for municipal and prefectural assemblies. Although the measure likely will be defeated in the House of Peers, advocates of woman suffrage hail it is a victory presaging full enfranchisement for women in a few years. . —The Associated Press learned here today that an important agreement has been concluded between the Nanking government and the Japanese war office whereby at least 30 Japanese army officers would be employed as instructors and organizers by the Chinese National army. Falling Missile Hits Man. Felled by a missile falling from a new building at North Capitol and G streets last night, Harry Holland. 52 years old, of Towson, Md., was taken to the Emergency Hospital with a fractured skull and lacerations of the head and hands.
